text:
Maria L: Hey team — small PR up (https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/PR-2087). Changes are an adaptive KV-evict heuristic + a minor quantized-kernel toggle. Can someone sanity-check perf/cost numbers before I merge? :pray:

Aj Patel: On it. Quick summary of what you measured locally?

Maria L: baseline (master) on rtx-8000: p50=42ms, p95=130ms, tokens/sec ~220; cost proxy (inferred) = 0.98x. With PR-2087: p50=44ms, p95=140ms, tokens/sec ~235; cost proxy = 0.91x. So cost down ~9-10% but tail latency up ~8%.

Simon K: Can you paste the exact config diff?

Maria L: Sure — small snippet:
```yaml
kv_cache:
  eviction: adaptive
  adaptive:
    target_kv_ratio: 0.6
    window_ms: 2000
quantized_kernel:
  enable_small_batch_fastpath: true
```

Kevin R: Hm, target_kv_ratio 0.6 might increase cache churn for longer contexts. That could explain p95 increase. Did you try lowering window_ms?

Maria L: I did a quick sweep: window_ms=500 gave p95 closer to 135ms but token throughput drops to 225. 2000 gives best throughput.

Jen W: What's the expected customer impact? If cost drops 10% but p95 worse, do we still meet SLAs for Dedicated tiers?

Maria L: For most hosted customers it's within SLOs, Dedicated p95 SLA is 150ms for the affected model tier — we're under that at 140ms. But for a subset of latency-sensitive customers it's borderline.

Aj Patel: CI run? any automated perf checks?

CI Bot: CI: unit tests passed. Perf-smoke: baseline vs PR fork run on CI-machines:
- p50 delta: +2ms
- p95 delta: +9ms
- throughput delta: +6%
All checks: PASSED 

Simon K: Quick code comments left on the PR about tightening the adaptive backoff and adding a feature-flag for the kernel toggle. Also request: add a tiny perf test that runs the 1024-context path.

Maria L: Thanks — added comments addressed, pushed a follow-up commit that makes the quantized kernel toggle gated behind `enable_small_batch_fastpath` feature flag and added perf-smoke-1024 job.

Kevin R: Can we do a staged rollout? Canary to 5% and monitor cost & p95 for an hour?

Maria L: Yep — I can do canary if we merge. Any objections to merge now with canary plan?

Aj Patel: I'll give a quick :eyes: and merge if CI green and Simon's comments are addressed.

Jen W: Please tag support and include the rollout notes so they can watch latency alerts for VIP customers.

Maria L: Will do. Rollout plan in PR description updated with alerting playbook and rollback steps.

DeployBot: Staging canary image built: gcr.redwood/staging/pr-2087:canary-2026-03-17-1052

CI Bot: Perf-smoke-1024: completed — p95 reported 138ms on the canary image, throughput +5.8%.

Aj Patel: Looks reasonable. LGTM from me. I'm going to merge and kick off a 5% canary.

Simon K: :thumbsup: watch the kv eviction metrics (kv.hit_ratio, kv.evictions/s) during the canary. If hit_ratio drops >6% or evictions spike >30%, rollback.

Maria L: Noted. Merging now. Thanks all! :tada:
